description: This PHP class 'FormatWithPayGradeId' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to format pay grade IDs into their corresponding names by fetching data from a pay grade service.

classes.name: FormatWithPayGradeId
classes.description: A class that formats pay grade IDs into their respective pay grade names using a service lookup.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Fetches the PayGrade entity by ID and returns its name if found; otherwise, returns null.
